title: Fisher-Informational Time: A Causal-Geometric Framework for Emergent Clock Time Physical Distinguishability
summary: We develop a Fisher-informational reformulation of physical time in which clock time is not regarded as a fundamental ontological substance, but as an emergent calibration of causally ordered distinguishability among physical states. The operational starting point is that clocks do not measure time itself; rather, they instantiate reproducible physical processes whose distinguishable states are correlated with other events.
